name: type
label: Type
help: Choose whether to create a lead list or an account list.

name: name
label: Name
help: List name, up to 75 characters. Spaces at the start and end are removed. If you already have a list of this type with exactly the same name, including a built-in list, the module fails and no list is created. Letter case counts.

name: description
label: Description
help: Optional list description, up to 350 characters.
